description: Laravel-aware project detection, navigation and tooling for Red Code.
untrustedDescription: Project detection and read-only information are available. Commands that run PHP are disabled in Restricted Mode.
phpPathDescription: Absolute path to `php.exe`. Leave empty to detect Herd's active PHP or `php.exe` on PATH. Batch files are not accepted.
showVendorDescription: Show routes registered by installed packages in the Routes view.
maxFilesDescription: Maximum number of project files scanned for the Laravel index. Larger projects stop scanning at this limit instead of degrading the editor.
autoRefreshDescription: Rebuild the Laravel index a few seconds after PHP, Blade, composer or .env files change.
